I have implemented full query state preservation for fine-grained persisted queries across `@tanstack/query-core`, `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`, and the framework adapters, and committed the changes on the branch `feat/persister-restore-result`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **`createPersisterRestoreResult` & Core Query Restoration (`@tanstack/query-core`)**:
   - Exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L178-L193) and [`isPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L195-L205) from [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/index.ts#L10-L15), and updated [`QueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L127-L147) in [types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/types.ts) to accept `PersisterRestoreResult` return values.
   - Added [`Query.restoreState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L430-L438) and [`normalizeRestoredState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L118-L176) in [query.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/query.ts), updating [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L708-L735) so that when a persister returns a restore result marker, the query adopts the restored snapshot state (`status`, `fetchStatus: 'idle'`, `error`, `dataUpdateCount`, `errorUpdateCount`, `fetchFailureCount`, `fetchFailureReason`, `dataUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdatedAt`, `isInvalidated`, `fetchMeta`, and infinite query `pages`/`pageParams`) without triggering normal `QueryCache` `onSuccess`/`onSettled` fetch callbacks.
   - Updated [`QueryObserver.createResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L555-L625), [`shouldLoadOnMount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L814-L828), [`shouldFetchOnMount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L842-L867), and [`shouldFetchOptionally`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L829-L840) in [queryObserver.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts) so restored queries expose their persisted error/refetch-error state, failure counters, and timestamps during mount instead of being overwritten by optimistic mount fetch state.
   - Updated [useBaseQuery.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts#L120-L137) in `@tanstack/vue-query` to ensure observer subscriptions are also attached when using a core `QueryClient`.

2. **Fine-Grained Persister & Bulk Restoration Reconciliation (`@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`)**:
   - Updated [`persisterFn`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L283-L353) in [createPersister.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts) to return `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data, state })` and avoid overwriting persisted error/invalidated snapshots after restore.
   - Updated [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L387-L448) and added [`reconcileRestoredQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L81-L152) to restore full query snapshots in bulk and independently merge data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`) when reconciling with existing in-memory queries.

3. **Tests**:
   - Added unit and integration tests in [query.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-core/src/__tests__/query.test.tsx), [createPersister.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersister.test.ts), [react-query/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/react-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx), [preact-query/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/preact-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx), [solid-query/useQuery.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/solid-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.tsx), [vue-query/useQuery.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/vue-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.ts), [svelte-query/createQuery.svelte.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/svelte-query/tests/createQuery.svelte.test.ts), and [angular-query-experimental/inject-query.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-cni8gf0f/packages/angular-query-experimental/src/__tests__/inject-query.test.ts).
